<td class="pl custom" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_xero_BusinessLoansAndLinesCreditDisclosureTextBlock', window );">BUSINESS LOANS AND LINES OF CREDIT</a></td>
<td class="text"><p id="xdx_80A_ecustom--BusinessLoansAndLinesCreditDisclosureTextBlock_zOaVaeaAPFgk" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b><span>NOTE 5: <span id="xdx_82B_zFsr2WTjK1Z6">BUSINESS LOANS AND LINES OF CREDIT</span></span></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company&#8217;s outstanding borrowings
consisted of the following as of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"></p>




<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="text-decoration: underline">JP Morgan Chase Line of Credit</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On November 12, 2024, the Company entered into
a credit agreement with JP Morgan Chase comprised of a term commitment for $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--LinesOfCreditCurrent_c20241112__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--JPMorganChaseTermCommitmentMember_pp0p" title="Line of credit">2,000,000</span> and a revolving commitment for $<span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--LinesOfCreditCurrent_c20241112__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--JPMorganChaseRevolvingCommitmentMember_pp0p" title="Line of credit">4,000,000</span>. The term
commitment had a maturity date of <span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityExpirationDate1_c20261101__20261112__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--JPMorganChaseTermCommitmentMember_z3XGJLPhpSs2" title="Line of credit, maturity">November 12, 2025</span>, at which time payment of the full principal amount was due. The revolving commitment
had a maturity on <span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityExpirationDate1_c20261101__20261112__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--JPMorganChaseRevolvingCommitmentMember_zEj7NQm6lQ7i" title="Line of credit, maturity">November 12, 2025</span>. On February 2, 2023, the Company drew and utilized the full credit available under the revolving
commitment of $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityRemainingBorrowingCapacity_c20230202__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--JPMorganChaseRevolvingCommitmentMember_pp0p" title="Credit available under line of credit">4,000,000</span>. In 2025, JPMorgan extended the maturity date of the revolving lines of credit to February of 2026.&#160;&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;The interest rate for the revolving commitment
is <span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityInterestRateDescription_c20261101__20261112__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--JPMorganChaseRevolvingCommitmentMember_z2X0QQG9RBRe" title="Interest rate, description">OFR plus 3.250%</span>. For the year ending December 31, 2025, the weighted average interest rates for the revolving commitment was approximately
<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityInterestRateDuringPeriod_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--JPMorganChaseRevolvingCommitmentMember_pd" title="Interest rate">7.49%</span>. Additionally, a commitment fee of 0.25% is paid on the unused balance of the revolving commitment. Borrowings under this credit
agreement are secured by substantially all the assets of the Company.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The credit agreement required the Company to maintain
a minimum total leverage ratio of 2.50 and a minimum fixed-charge coverage ratio of 1.20. Additionally, the credit agreement limits the
Company&#8217;s indebtedness, in addition to various covenants. As of December 31, 2025, the Company was in compliance with all financial
covenants under the credit agreement.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="text-decoration: underline">Wells Fargo Line of Credit</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On February 5, 2026, the Company entered into
a credit agreement with Wells Fargo for a revolving commitment of $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--LinesOfCreditCurrent_c20260205__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WellsFargoRevolvingCommitmentMember_pp0p">12,000,000</span>.
The commitment has a maturity on <span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityExpirationDate1_c20260201__20260205__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WellsFargoRevolvingCommitmentMember_z1syEmGaY8s4">February
5, 2029</span>. The Company utilized $<span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityRemainingBorrowingCapacity_c20260205__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WellsFargoRevolvingCommitmentMember_pp0p">4,000,000</span>
of the credit available under the revolving commitment to repay its maturing commitment to JP Morgan Chase.&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The interest rate for the Wells Fargo revolving
commitment is <span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityInterestRateDescription_c20260201__20260205__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WellsFargoRevolvingCommitmentMember_zW8CGJx51rI1" title="Interest rate, description">Daily Simple SOFR plus 2.250%</span>.&#160; For the three months and six months ended June 30, 2026, the weighted average interest
rates for the revolving commitment was approximately <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityInterestRateDuringPeriod_c20260401__20260630__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WellsFargoRevolvingCommitmentMember_zpYQAX8guMX6" title="Interest rate">5.88%</span> and <span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityInterestRateDuringPeriod_c20260101__20260630__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WellsFargoRevolvingCommitmentMember_pd" title="Interest rate">5.92%</span>, respectively. Additionally, a commitment fee of 0.25% is paid on
the unused balance of the revolving commitment. Borrowings under this credit agreement are secured by substantially all the assets of
the Company.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The credit agreement requires the Company to maintain
a minimum fixed-charge coverage ratio of 1.0 through June 2026 and a minimum of 1.1 from July 2026 forward. Additionally, the credit agreement
limits the Company&#8217;s indebtedness, in addition to various covenants. As of June 30, 2026, the Company was in compliance with all
financial covenants under the credit agreement.&#160;&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">As of June 30, 2026, the balance of the revolving
commitment was $<span id="xdx_903_ecustom--RevolvingCommitment_iI_pp0d_c20260630__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--RevolvingCommitmentMember_z3TqUGakn3Vb" title="Revolving commitment">2,063,629</span> which is presented net of unamortized debt discounts of $<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscountCurrent_c20260630__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--RevolvingCommitmentMember_pp0p" title="Unamortized debt discounts">207,335</span> for a carrying amount of $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--LineOfCredit_c20260630__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--RevolvingCommitmentMember_pp0p" title="Carrying amount">1,856,294</span> on the Company&#8217;s
condensed consolidated balance sheet. Total interest expense for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 was $<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--InterestExpense_pp0d_c20260401__20260630_zGTY8NWbrpL8" title="Interest expense">102,818</span> and $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--InterestExpense_pp0d_c20260101__20260630_zAhBRE76TzO8" title="Interest expense">191,609</span>,
respectively.&#160;Total interest expense for the three and six months ended June 30, 2025 was $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--InterestExpense_pp0d_c20250401__20250630_zCQoPB33Ord" title="Interest expense">111,285</span> and $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--InterestExpense_pp0d_c20250101__20250630_zBb5LQWhUw25" title="Interest expense">219,724</span>, respectively.&#160;</p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>
